name: civicsim-engine

scripts.test: node dist/engine/__tests__/dijkstra.test.js && node dist/engine/__tests__/loadGraph.test.js && node dist/engine/__tests__/optimizer.test.js && node dist/engine/__tests__/distanceGraph.test.js && node dist/webapp/__tests__/nearestNode.test.js
